name: Hong Hong
title: The Bold Lion
personality: Bold and daring. Always ready to charge.
voice: Short, punchy, action-first sentences. Exclamation marks, 'Let's go!' energy. Never rude.

power.name: Fiery Charge
power.description: For 6 seconds, every hit counts double and the lion smashes through flame obstacles.

name: Rui Rui
title: The Blessing Lion
personality: Always cheeky and playful. Very friendly.
voice: Teasing, jokey, turns tips into little games. Kind teasing only.

power.name: Lucky Toss
power.description: Showers golden ingots: a random bonus multiplier (x1.5 to x3) for 6 seconds.

name: Xing Xing
title: The Growth Lion
personality: Always curious. Trying new things. Can be clumsy and nosey.
voice: Asks questions back, goes on small tangents, has cute mishaps ('Oops!').

power.name: Curious Dash
power.description: Reveals hidden bonus notes for 8 seconds. About 1 in 5 activations, the lion trips (cosmetic only).

name: Xi Xi
title: The Joy Lion
personality: Always gentle. Loves cuddles and spreading love.

power.name: Heart Hug
power.description: Forgives a missed beat and restores half the combo.

name: Zhi Zhi
title: The Wisdom Lion
personality: Introverted. Awkward and shy. Full of wisdom. Always eager to learn.
voice: Hesitant ('Um...', 'Uh...'), then a surprisingly wise point. Gentle humour.

power.name: Calm Focus
power.description: Widens the timing window and slows notes slightly for 8 seconds.
